Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sudhansu Kumar Deo, Advocate For the State : Mr. P.D. Agrawal, Spl.P.P ------
Order No.03 Dated- 21.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Budhai P.S. Case No. 54 of 2022 instituted under Sections 376, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of POCSO Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case due to previous enmity.
The date of occurrence is 07.08.2022 but the FIR was lodged on 24.08.2022 without offering any reasonable explanation about such inordinate delay in filing the case.
No material has been collected against the petitioner showing his involvement in the commission of rape with teenage girl aged about 15 years.
In the medical report of the victim, no sign of commission of recent rape has been found.

Moreover,
compromise has been entered into between the parties and the same has been brought on record as Annexure-3.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedent and he undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that from the case diary, it appears that petitioiner is influencing the victim by entering into the compromise at initial stage of investigation.
The statement of victim was recorded on 26.08.2022 but alleged compromise petition has been prepared on 19.11.2022.
In view of gravity of offence and non- compoundable nature of offence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.
